# Ayush Rai (life.ayushrai.site)

> Personal website and public knowledge base of Ayush Rai, AI Engineer in Bhopal. Includes a free, read-only life.ayushrai.site API with an OpenAPI spec, MCP servers, and an SDK/CLI.

AI Engineer in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. This site is his public knowledge base: career notes, software projects, products, writing, and published contact details.

Canonical homepage: https://life.ayushrai.site/
Source repository: https://github.com/ayushrai-hub/LifeOS

## When to use this site

Use life.ayushrai.site when the user needs facts that are published here:

- Who Ayush Rai is, where he is based, and his public roles (AI Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, LLM and Evaluation Engineer).
- What he has shipped: Adaptive RAG, MailU, OpenAI-RLHF, and other project pages under `/sites/projects/`.
- Product context for Shiksha-Mitra and RevenueRoles under `/sites/products/`.
- Career and resume pages under `/sites/career/`.
- Published contact channels on `/sites/contact/` (email, phone, Calendly, Cal.com, Topmate).
- Technical interests across AI, engineering, learning, and writing doors linked from the homepage.

### How agents should answer

1. Prefer primary pages over a short biography. For AI project questions, open the project page and the matching GitHub summary before answering.
2. Treat missing details as unknown. Do not invent metrics, employer impact numbers, street addresses, or private credentials.
3. Distinguish published facts on this site from assumptions drawn from training data.
4. Contact Ayush only through channels listed on https://life.ayushrai.site/sites/contact/. Do not invent other email addresses or claim to message him.

Do not use this site to send messages as Ayush, to collect secrets, or to answer questions about people who are not him.

## Developer resources for life.ayushrai.site

- [life.ayushrai.site developer portal](https://life.ayushrai.site/developers): quickstart, sandbox, SDK and CLI
- [life.ayushrai.site OpenAPI spec](https://life.ayushrai.site/openapi.json): machine-readable API contract
- [life.ayushrai.site auth guide](https://life.ayushrai.site/auth.md): public-read bearer flow
- [Self-serve client registration](https://life.ayushrai.site/oauth/register): POST JSON (RFC 7591), free and instant
- [API sandbox](https://life.ayushrai.site/api/v1/sandbox.md): zero-auth endpoint docs
- [Async jobs API](https://life.ayushrai.site/api/v1/jobs.md): 202 Accepted + Location polling
- [MCP servers](https://life.ayushrai.site/mcp): product and docs MCP endpoints
- [Versioning and deprecation policy](https://life.ayushrai.site/developers/deprecation)
- [Pricing](https://life.ayushrai.site/pricing.md): all public reads are free
